title: job.submitted (v1)
description: Work dispatch for a backtest or live job. Published only by job-orchestrator's outbox relay, with publisher confirms, to `lean.jobs` with routing key `jobs.backtest.v1` (AMQP type `jobs.v1.BacktestRequested`) or `jobs.live.v1` (`jobs.v1.LiveRequested`). Consumed by backtest-worker / live-worker as competing consumers. Optimizations, reports and market-data tasks have their own dispatch messages.

attempt.description: Attempt the orchestrator expects (1 for a new job, n+1 when it re-publishes after a lost worker). The worker confirms it with `POST /internal/v1/jobs/{jobId}/attempts` before starting.

submittedBy.description: User id (gateway) or `optimizer` for child backtests.

parentJobId.description: Optimization job id when this backtest was generated by the optimizer (`OptimizationId` in the engine's packets).

deadline.description: Backtests: the orchestrator cancels the attempt if it is still running at this time. Absent for live.
